708849.t: From Proto-Indo-European *méǵʰ(s)ri (locative), from *me (“with”) (see also μετά (metá)) + *ǵʰes- (“hand”) (whence χείρ (kheír, “hand”)).

708892.t: From Proto-Hellenic *mā́tēr (compare Mycenaean Greek 𐀔𐀳𐀩 (ma-te-re), Doric μάτηρ (mā́tēr)), from Proto-Indo-European *méh₂tēr.

708874.t: From Proto-Hellenic *méns (“month”), from Proto-Indo-European *mḗh₁n̥s (“moon, month”), probably from *meh₁- (“to measure”). Cognate with Mycenaean Greek 𐀕𐀜 (me-no), Latin mēnsis (“month”), and English moon, month.

708851.t: From Proto-Hellenic *mḗ, from Proto-Indo-European *méh₁ (prohibitive particle). Cognate with Old Armenian մի (mi), Sanskrit मा (mā́), Old Persian 𐎶𐎠 (m-a /⁠mā⁠/), and Albanian mos.

708870.t: Uncertain. Compare Hittite 𒈠𒀀𒄴𒆷𒀸 (māḫlaš, “grapevine”), Hittite 𒊭𒈠𒇻 (šamalu-, “apple”), Hittite 𒊭𒄠𒇻 (šamlu-, “apple”) and Proto-Kartvelian *msxal- (“pear”).

708838.t: From μετέχω (metékhō, “to take part”) + -η (-ē, abstract noun suffix).

708822.t: From μετα- (meta-, indicating change) + φέρω (phérō, “bear, carry”).

708868.t: From Proto-Hellenic *mā́kos, from Proto-Indo-European *méh₂ḱos. Cognates include Avestan 𐬨𐬀𐬯𐬀𐬵 (masah), Latin maciēs, and Hittite [script needed] (mak-l-ant-).

708885.t: From Proto-Hellenic *mḗros, of uncertain ultimate origin. Maybe from Proto-Indo-European *mḗms, *mēms-rom (“flesh”).

708803.t: Likely from Pre-Greek because of the presence of -αλλ- (-all-).

708831.t: For μετήορος (metḗoros), from μετά (metá, “beyond”) + *ἀορος (*aoros), an o-grade noun from ἀείρω (aeírō, “to lift up, raise”).

708878.t: Unknown. The long vowel makes it unlikely to be from the same root as μανία (mănĭ́ā).

708881.t: Uncertain. Perhaps from Proto-Hellenic *mānúō, from Proto-Indo-European *mh₂néwti, a nu-infix formation to *(s)meh₂- (“to beckon”).

708855.t: From μή (mḗ, “not”) + δέ (dé, “and, but”). Compare οὐδέ (oudé, “but not, and not”).

708809.t: From μετα- (metă-, prefix indicating change) + νοέω (noéō, “perceive by the eyes, observe”).

708882.t: From μή (mḗ, “not”) + ποτέ (poté, “ever, at some time”).

708867.t: From μή (mḗ, “not”) + ἔτι (éti, “yet”), with κ (k) by analogy with οὐκέτι (oukéti).

708810.t: From μετανοέω (metanoéō, “a change of mind, change of attitude”) + -ια (-ĭă).

708824.t: From μετα- (metă-, “behind”) + φρήν (phrḗn, “midriff”), literally “the part behind the midriff”.

708808.t: μετα- (meta-) + ἀνίστημι (anístēmi), itself from ἀνα- (ana-) + ἵστημι (hístēmi).

708893.t: Univerbation of μή (mḗ, “so that...not, lest”) + τι (ti, “anything”).
